checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Compare decoded FK TCP position in metres, rotation angle in radians, and gripper scalar against the demonstrated commanded TCP target. The source-frame pose conversion is invertible on labels; nonunique arm joints are accepted. Sampled 6-D rotations are projected to SO(3).

contract.cut_relation: Covers every assigned action in all twelve [600,stop) segments without trimming. It preserves the complete 250-action [600,850) overlap per trajectory with red_transfer, including red release, transit, blue approach, closure and lift.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is an unnormalized Cartesian target [p_x,p_y,p_z,r6_1..r6_6,gripper] in the blue block pose frame frozen from the causal current observation at chunk sampling. Position is metres, rotation is the first two columns of the target rotation in that frame, and gripper retains the demonstrated scalar/sign semantics. Slot 0 represents t-1; execution uses slots 1..8 for t..t+7. decode_action Gram-Schmidt projects 6-D rotation (with a deterministic finite degeneracy fallback), composes source_world @ target_source, and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured joints.
contract.parameter_semantics: source_object selects the current observed blue_pose. destination_field selects the calibrated observed blue_goal in world metres. Both selectors are resolved causally at each replan and are not actuator commands.
